findings.title: The advanced flag is passed to the pagination helper instead of the paginator constructor
findings.body: `enable_advanced_features` is an `OptimizedCursorPaginator.__init__` argument, but this call supplies it to `self.paginate`. The endpoint pagination helper does not expose this as a paginator-constructor option, so an optimized request will fail with an unexpected keyword argument (or, if helper kwargs are forwarded to `get_result`, `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result` will reject it there). Consequently every authorized request using `optimized_pagination=true` fails before returning audit logs. Construct the paginator with this option through supported helper plumbing, or remove the unused option.

findings.title: OptimizedCursorPaginator cannot paginate the audit-log datetime sort key
findings.body: The audit-log endpoint selects this paginator with `order_by="-datetime"`, so `item.datetime` is a `datetime.datetime`. `get_item_key` calls `math.floor`/`math.ceil` on that datetime while `build_cursor` is processing the first nonempty page, which raises `TypeError` rather than producing a response. Unlike `DateTimePaginator`, this class also does not convert cursor values back to datetimes for the ranged query. The optimized paginator must reuse the datetime key encoding/decoding from `DateTimePaginator` (or otherwise support datetime keys) before it can be used by this endpoint.

findings.title: The advertised negative-offset path uses an invalid Django QuerySet slice
findings.body: When advanced features are enabled and a cursor has a negative offset, this slices the Django `QuerySet` with a negative start. Django explicitly rejects negative QuerySet indexing/slicing with `ValueError: Negative indexing is not supported`; it does not implement the boundary handling described in the comments. Since `Cursor` accepts signed offsets, an advanced cursor with a negative offset produces a server error instead of reverse pagination. Reject such cursors as invalid or implement reverse traversal using non-negative queryset bounds.
